summary: Lakefront Biotherapeutics NV (formerly Galapagos NV), a Belgian biopharmaceutical company, filed a Form 6-K on August 25, 2026, reporting a transparency notification received from Bank of America Corporation under Belgian transparency legislation. The notification discloses that Bank of America crossed the 10% voting-rights threshold on August 18, 2026, holding 1,419,144 direct voting rights (2.15%) and 5,243,453 equivalent financial instruments (7.96%), totaling 10.11% of 65,897,071 outstanding shares. This is a routine regulatory disclosure of a shareholding stake change, not a special-situation corporate action. What to watch: potential further stake increases or activism by Bank of America, but no deal or strategic initiative is announced.
